_comment: Read by scripts/api-compat.py. Every entry changes how a change to the public contract is
classified, so a change to this file is itself reported for review. Type names are fully
qualified with dots, nested types included (Outer.Inner).

inputOnlyTypes._comment: Sealed or enum types a caller only ever passes in, never receives and matches on. A new subtype or entry of one of these is additive. Every other sealed or enum type counts as one a caller may match exhaustively, so a new subtype or entry is breaking.

closedForImplementation._comment: Interfaces and abstract classes consumers may not implement (each carrying @SubclassOptInRequired with an error-level marker). A new abstract member of one of these is additive. Empty until the public API work decides it, so every public interface counts as one a consumer may implement.

persistedContract._comment: Files that pin a stored format as exact literals. A change to any of them means a stored format, a reserved name or a persisted key changed, or its pin was loosened; either way a person confirms it and the changelog says what happens to data already on a device.

upstreamPins._comment: Catalog versions whose major or minor change reaches consumers as a different upstream API and binds them to it. A patch change is patch-safe.

toolchainFloors._comment: Catalog versions that set a floor for consumers. kotlin: a change of the tooling release (2.4.1x to 2.4.2x, or any minor) raises the Kotlin a consumer needs. increaseOnly: any increase.
